definition_zh: 再一次；又；回到原状
definition_en: one more time, or back to a former state or place
core_image: 钟摆荡到一端，又慢慢回到原来的位置
scene: 他把信读了一遍，又从头读第二遍。She read the letter again from the beginning.
sceneCN: 这里的 again 是「再一次」（第 1 个义项：重复同一动作）；句意是她又从开头把信读了一遍。

pos.zh: 副词：再一次；又；回到原状

derivatives.zh: 由同一古英语词演变而来，义为「反对；靠着」
同源词，义为「否认；反驳」

senses.title: One more time
senses.definition: a second or further time, repeating an action that has already happened
senses.definitionCN: 第二次或更多次，重复已经发生过的动作
senses.example: She read the letter again from the beginning.
senses.exampleCN: 她又从开头把信读了一遍。
senses.why: Old English ongean meant 'towards, opposite'; a movement that turns back towards its starting point naturally comes to mean doing something once more.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 ongean 意为「朝向、相对」；一个转身回到起点的动作，自然引申为把事情再做一次。

senses.title: Back to a former state
senses.definition: back to a healthy, normal, or previous condition after a change
senses.definitionCN: 经过变化之后回到健康、正常或原先的状态
senses.example: It was good to be home again after a month away.
senses.exampleCN: 离开一个月后回到家，感觉真好。
senses.why: The same return can describe a person rather than an action: to be well again is to have come back to the state you left.
senses.whyCN: 同一种「返回」也可以描述人而不是动作：be well again 就是回到先前离开的状态。

intro.en: A word of turning back, which split into again and against.
intro.cn: 一个表示「转回来」的词，后来分成了 again 与 against。

items.en: ongean meant towards, opposite, or back against something.
items.cn: ongean 意为「朝向、相对、反过来对着」。

items.en: The form ayen developed in Middle English and served both the 'back' and the 'opposite' senses.
items.cn: 中古英语发展出 ayen 这一形式，兼有「回来」与「相对」两义。

items.en: One branch became again, used for repetition and return.
items.cn: 一支变成了 again，用于重复与返回。

items.en: The other branch became against, used for opposition and contact.
items.cn: 另一支变成了 against，用于对立与接触。

items.en: Modern English keeps the two words apart, though both still carry the old idea of turning to face something.
items.cn: 现代英语把这两个词分开，但两者都仍带着「转过来面对」的旧意象。

note.en: The first group shares the old turning root; the second gathers expressions for repetition.
note.cn: 第一组共享古老的「转」词根；第二组收表示「重复」的说法。

definition_zh: 反对；靠着；与……对抗；以防
definition_en: opposed to something, touching something for support, competing with, or as a protection in case of
core_image: 两个人隔桌相对，手掌撑在桌沿上
scene: 投票前，两派在市政厅外举着牌子对立。Most residents voted against the new road.
sceneCN: 这里的 against 是「反对」（第 1 个义项：不赞成并站在对立面）；句意是多数居民投票反对这条新路。

pos.zh: 介词：反对；靠着；对抗；以防

derivatives.zh: against 在诗歌与方言中的缩略形式，义为「对着；反对」
由 there 与 against 合成的法律用语，义为「对此；反对此事」

senses.title: Opposed to something
senses.definition: in opposition to a plan, rule, person, or idea
senses.definitionCN: 对某项计划、规则、人或理念持反对态度
senses.example: Most residents voted against the new road.
senses.exampleCN: 多数居民投票反对这条新路。
senses.why: The old word meant 'turned towards and facing'; a person facing a proposal in order to resist it is against it.
senses.whyCN: 这个旧词意为「转过来正对着」；一个人正对着某项提议并加以抵抗，就是反对它。

senses.title: Touching for support
senses.definition: in contact with a surface, especially for rest or support
senses.definitionCN: 与某个表面接触，尤指为了休息或支撑
senses.example: He leaned the ladder against the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 他把梯子靠在墙上。
senses.why: To face something and touch it is also to lean on it; the same contact serves either resistance or support.
senses.whyCN: 面朝某物并与之接触，也可以是倚靠它；同一种接触既可用于抵抗，也可用于支撑。

senses.title: In competition with
senses.definition: in a contest, fight, or comparison with an opponent
senses.definitionCN: 在竞赛、战斗或比较中面对对手
senses.example: The youth team played against a much older side.
senses.exampleCN: 青年队与一支年龄大得多的队伍比赛。
senses.why: Two sides set face to face form a contest; the word marks the opponent on the other side of the line.
senses.whyCN: 两方正面相对就构成竞赛；这个词标记界线另一侧的对手。

senses.title: As a protection in case of
senses.definition: as a defence or preparation for a possible future need
senses.definitionCN: 作为对将来某种需要的防范或准备
senses.example: They saved a little money against a rainy day.
senses.exampleCN: 他们存了一点钱以备不时之需。
senses.why: What you set facing a future risk is a shield; the word shifts from opposition to precaution.
senses.whyCN: 你摆在未来风险对面的东西就是盾牌；这个词于是从「对抗」转为「预防」。

definition_zh: 年龄；时代；变老；很长一段时间
definition_en: the number of years someone or something has lived, a historical period, the process of growing old, or a very long time
core_image: 一棵树的年轮一圈套着一圈，越靠外越年轻
scene: 她翻开相册，指着一张黑白照片说起从前。He left home at the age of eighteen.
sceneCN: 这里的 age 是「年龄」（第 1 个义项：人或物已经存在的时间长度）；句意是他十八岁时离开家。

pos.zh: 名词：年龄；时代；很长一段时间
动词：变老；使显老

derivatives.zh: 由过去分词转作形容词，义为「年老的；……岁的」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「老化；衰老」
加 -less 构成，义为「不显老的；永恒的」
加 -ism 构成，义为「年龄歧视」

senses.title: How old someone is
senses.definition: the number of years a person, animal, or thing has existed
senses.definitionCN: 人、动物或事物已经存在的年数
senses.example: He left home at the age of eighteen.
senses.exampleCN: 他十八岁时离开家。
senses.why: Latin aetas meant a span of life; English age first named the length of a life, then the number that records it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 aetas 指一段生命跨度；英语 age 先指生命的长度，后指记录这个长度的数字。

senses.title: A historical period
senses.definition: a long period of history with a particular character or technology
senses.definitionCN: 具有某种特征或技术的漫长历史时期
senses.example: The digital age changed how we read.
senses.exampleCN: 数字时代改变了我们的阅读方式。
senses.why: The span of one life widened by analogy to the span of a civilisation, and any marked period became an age.
senses.whyCN: 一个人的生命跨度被类比放大为文明的跨度，任何特征鲜明的时期都成了一个时代。

senses.title: To grow old
senses.definition: to become older, or to make someone or something look older
senses.definitionCN: 变老，或使某人某物显得更老
senses.example: Worry had aged him in a single year.
senses.exampleCN: 忧虑让他在一年之内就显老了。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb: to undergo the passing of years is to age.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词：经历岁月的流逝，就是 age。

senses.title: A very long time
senses.definition: in informal British English, ages means a very long time
senses.definitionCN: 非正式英式英语中，ages 指很长一段时间
senses.example: I haven't seen her for ages.
senses.exampleCN: 我很久没见过她了。
senses.why: If an age is a whole historical period, waiting for ages is waiting so long that it feels like one.
senses.whyCN: 既然一个 age 是一整个历史时期，等上 ages 就是久得像过了一个时代。

definition_en: a business or organization that acts for others, a government office, or the power to act and produce effects
core_image: 一间临街的小办公室，玻璃门上贴着某某事务所
scene: 她被派去一家专门安排演出的公司实习。The agency finds work for young actors.
sceneCN: 这里的 agency 是「代理机构」（第 1 个义项：替他人办理事务的机构）；句意是这家经纪公司为年轻演员找工作。

pos.zh: 名词：代理机构；经纪公司；政府机构；能动作用

derivatives.zh: 由同一词根构成，义为「代理人；作用剂」
同出拉丁语 agere，义为「议程」
加 -ial 构成，义为「代理的；能动者的」（学术用语）

senses.title: A business acting for others
senses.definition: a company that arranges services or deals on behalf of other people
senses.definitionCN: 替他人安排服务或处理交易的公司
senses.example: The agency finds work for young actors.
senses.exampleCN: 这家经纪公司为年轻演员找工作。
senses.why: Latin agentia meant 'the doing of things'; a business that does things on your behalf is literally your doing-power.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 agentia 意为「做事」；一家替你办事的公司，字面上就是你的「行动力」。

senses.title: A government office
senses.definition: an official body with a particular public function
senses.definitionCN: 承担某项公共职能的官方机构
senses.example: The environmental agency fined the factory.
senses.exampleCN: 环保机构对这家工厂开了罚单。
senses.why: Public bodies also act for the state; the same word for delegated action serves government departments.
senses.whyCN: 公共机构也是替国家行事；同一个表示「受托行动」的词，也就用于政府部门。

senses.title: The power to act
senses.definition: the capacity of a person or thing to act and produce an effect
senses.definitionCN: 人或事物行动并产生效果的能力
senses.example: The essay asks how much human agency shapes history.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章追问人的能动性在多大程度上塑造历史。
senses.why: Behind every agency is the verb agere, to do; the abstract noun names the bare power of doing.
senses.whyCN: 每个 agency 背后都是动词 agere「做」；这个抽象名词指的就是纯粹的「做」的能力。

intro.en: From a Latin verb of doing, through a noun of delegated action.
intro.cn: 从拉丁语表示「做」的动词，经由表示「受托行动」的名词而来。

items.en: agere meant to do, drive, or set in motion, and gives act, agent and agenda.
items.cn: agere 意为做、驱动、推动，给出 act、agent 与 agenda。

items.en: The participle agens meant 'doing' or 'one who does', the source of agent.
items.cn: 分词 agens 意为「正在做的」或「做事者」，是 agent 的来源。

items.en: Medieval Latin agentia named the activity of doing or the office that does things for another.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 agentia 指做事的活动，或替他人办事的职务。

items.en: English borrowed agency for the office or function of an agent.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入 agency，指代理人的职务或职能。

items.en: The word widened to commercial firms, government bodies, and finally the abstract power to act.
items.cn: 这个词后来扩展到商业公司、政府机构，最后指抽象的「行动能力」。

note.en: The first group shares the doing root; the second gathers organizations that act for others.
note.cn: 第一组共享表示「做」的词根；第二组收替他人行事的组织。

entries.definition: a person who acts for another
entries.definitionCN: 代理人；经纪人

entries.definition: a list of things to be done
entries.definitionCN: 议程；待办事项

entries.definition: relating to an agent or to agency
entries.definitionCN: 代理的；能动者的

entries.definition: needing immediate action; a different Latin root
entries.definitionCN: 紧急的；词根不同

entries.definition: an office or department, often official
entries.definitionCN: 办事处；局

entries.definition: a business company
entries.definitionCN: 公司；商行

entries.definition: a group with a purpose, broader than agency
entries.definitionCN: 组织；范围比 agency 宽

entries.definition: the ability to act or produce change
entries.definitionCN: 力量；能力

normalIntro.en: The word is the abstract noun of agent, built on agere, to do.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 agent 的抽象名词，根子是 agere「做」。

normal.en: agent is the person, agency is the office or the power.
normal.cn: agent 是人，agency 是机构或能力。

normal.en: A travel agency arranges trips for other people.
normal.cn: 旅行社替别人安排行程。

normal.en: A government agency acts for the state.
normal.cn: 政府机构替国家行事。

normal.en: Human agency means people's power to act.
normal.cn: human agency 指人的行动能力。

normal.en: Spell it -ency, like urgency, not -ancy.
normal.cn: 词尾拼作 -ency，如 urgency，不是 -ancy。

abstract.en: Picture a small office with a sign on the glass, doing business for others.
abstract.cn: 想象一间小办公室，玻璃上贴着招牌，替别人办事。

abstract.en: See the same desk become a government counter with a stamp.
abstract.cn: 想象同一张桌子变成带印章的政府柜台。

abstract.en: Imagine an invisible hand of human action pushing history forward.
abstract.cn: 想象一只无形的人手把历史往前推。

examples.en: The agency finds work for young actors.
examples.cn: 这家经纪公司为年轻演员找工作。

examples.en: The environmental agency fined the factory.
examples.cn: 环保机构对这家工厂开了罚单。

examples.en: The essay asks how much human agency shapes history.
examples.cn: 这篇文章追问人的能动性在多大程度上塑造历史。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诶真希」——诶，真稀奇，一间小办事处替全城人跑腿。

root: 拉丁语 agere「做、推动」的分词 agens 生出 agent，中世纪拉丁语 agentia 指「做事的活动或职务」，十七世纪进入英语作 agency，后扩展为代理机构、政府机构与抽象的能动作用。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses move from a firm that acts for you, to a state body that acts for the public, to the bare human power of acting.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项从替你做事的公司，走到替公众行事的国家机关，再到人纯粹的「行动能力」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small office with a sign on the glass, doing business for others.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间玻璃门上贴招牌的小办公室，替他人办事。

branches.en: an agency booking work for actors
branches.cn: 替演员接工作的经纪公司

branches.en: a travel agency arranging a trip
branches.cn: 安排行程的旅行社

branches.en: an environmental body issuing a fine
branches.cn: 开出罚单的环保机构

branches.en: people's capacity to shape history
branches.cn: 人塑造历史的能力

branches.cn: 受托的行事、官方的行事，以及行事的能力

intro.en: A Latin verb of doing and the English noun ending -ency.
intro.cn: 一个表示「做」的拉丁动词，加英语名词词尾 -ency。

latinIntro.en: agere, agens and agentia are recorded Latin forms.
latinIntro.cn: agere、agens 与 agentia 都是有记录的拉丁形态。

definition_zh: 议程；议事日程；待办事项；政策议题
definition_en: a list of matters to be discussed or dealt with, especially at a meeting, or the set of issues a person or group is pushing
core_image: 会议桌上摊开的一页纸，事项按顺序一行行排好，等着被逐条划掉
scene: 会议室里人还没到齐，主席把那张纸先压在水杯下面。The first item on the agenda is next year's budget.
sceneCN: 这里 agenda 是「议程」（第 1 个义项：会议上按顺序讨论的事项清单）；句意为议程上的第一项是明年的预算。图中可辨识物件：长桌、水杯、一页纸。

pos.zh: 名词：议程；议事日程；待办事项；政策议题

collocations.zh: 隐藏的动机；台面下的目的
设定议题；掌握议程主导权

derivatives.zh: 拉丁语单数形式，罕用，义为「一件待议事项」
由 agenda 与 setting 合成的学术用语，义为「议题设定」

senses.title: A list for a meeting
senses.definition: a list of the matters to be discussed at a meeting, usually set out in order
senses.definitionCN: 会议将要讨论的事项清单，通常按顺序排列
senses.example: The chair circulated the agenda two days before the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 主席在会前两天发出了议程。
senses.why: Latin agenda means 'things that must be done'; a meeting's agenda is literally the list of things that meeting must do.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 agenda 本义是「必须做的事」；一场会议的 agenda 字面上就是这场会议必须处理的事项清单。

senses.title: The things one has to do
senses.definition: the matters a person or organisation has to deal with, not necessarily at a formal meeting
senses.definitionCN: 个人或机构需要处理的事项，不一定发生在正式会议上
senses.example: My agenda for today is three reports and a phone call.
senses.exampleCN: 我今天的待办事项是三份报告和一个电话。
senses.why: The same Latin plural was widened from meeting business to anyone's list of tasks, which is why it can describe a private working day.
senses.whyCN: 同一个拉丁复数从会议事务推广到任何人手上的任务清单，所以它能用来描述一个人的工作安排。

senses.title: A policy programme
senses.definition: the set of issues that a government, party, or group is committed to acting on
senses.definitionCN: 政府、政党或团体决心推动的一系列议题
senses.example: Climate change has moved to the top of the government's agenda.
senses.exampleCN: 气候变化已经升到政府议程的首位。
senses.why: Politics turned the meeting list into a programme: what is on the agenda is what that side intends to act on.
senses.whyCN: 政治把会议清单变成施政纲领：列在 agenda 上的，就是这一方打算推动的事。

senses.title: A concealed motive
senses.titleCN: 隐藏议程；台面下的目的
senses.definition: in the phrase hidden agenda, an unstated purpose behind what someone says or does
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 hidden agenda，指某人言行背后没有明说的目的
senses.example: The offer looked generous, but investors suspected a hidden agenda.
senses.exampleCN: 这个提议看起来很慷慨，但投资者怀疑背后另有目的。
senses.why: If an agenda is a list of intended actions, a hidden one is the same list kept off the table while the public one is shown.
senses.whyCN: 既然 agenda 是打算采取的行动清单，hidden agenda 就是公开那张之外、不肯摆上桌的那张。

intro.en: Agenda is a Latin plural that English borrowed whole, and it still carries the shape of a verb meaning 'to do'.
intro.cn: agenda 是英语整体借来的拉丁复数，至今仍保留着那个意为「做」的动词的形状。

items.en: The verb agere meant 'to do, drive, lead', and it also supplies agent, act and action.
items.cn: 动词 agere 意为「做、驱动、带领」，agent、act、action 也都出自它。

items.en: Agenda is the neuter plural of the gerundive agendus, 'that which must be done', so the word began life as a plural.
items.cn: agenda 是动形词 agendus「必须做的」的中性复数，所以这个词一开始就是复数。

items.en: Church and academic Latin used agenda for a list of matters to be transacted, often in the phrase agenda sunt.
items.cn: 教会拉丁语与学术拉丁语用 agenda 指待办事项清单，常见搭配是 agenda sunt。

items.en: English took it over as a plural noun for things to be done; the singular agendum was rare then and has stayed rare.
items.cn: 英语把它借来作复数名词，指待办之事；单数 agendum 当时就罕见，至今仍然罕见。

items.en: The political sense of 'issues to be pushed' developed in the twentieth century, and hidden agenda came with it.
items.cn: 「要推动的议题」这一政治义在二十世纪发展出来，hidden agenda 也随之出现。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same Latin verb of doing; the near-meaning group gathers lists and plans that differ in what they schedule.
note.cn: 形近组收同一个拉丁「做」动词构成的一族词；近义组收清单与计划类词，区别在于它们安排的是什么。

entries.definition: The rare Latin singular of agenda: a single item to be done.
entries.definitionCN: agenda 罕用的拉丁单数形式：一件待办事项。

entries.definition: A person or thing that acts or produces an effect.
entries.definitionCN: 行动或产生效果的人或物。

entries.definition: An organisation that acts for others, or the capacity to act.
entries.definitionCN: 代他人行事的机构，或行动的能力。

entries.definition: A plan that lists the times at which things will happen.
entries.definitionCN: 列出事情发生时间的计划。

entries.definition: A chart of the times of trains, classes, or events.
entries.definitionCN: 列车、课程或活动的时间表。

entries.definition: A planned series of events or actions.
entries.definitionCN: 预先安排的一系列活动或行动。

normalIntro.en: One Latin plural, borrowed whole, carries the entire word.
normalIntro.cn: 一个整体借入英语的拉丁复数，承载了整个词。

normal.en: Agenda is Latin for 'things to be done', so it starts life as a plural.
normal.cn: agenda 在拉丁语里就是「要做的事」，天生是复数。

normal.en: Picture a meeting sheet: each line is one agendum, the whole sheet is the agenda.
normal.cn: 想一张会议用纸：一行是一件 agendum，整张纸就是 agenda。

normal.en: Agenda and agent share agere, 'to do': an agent does, an agenda lists what is to be done.
normal.cn: agenda 与 agent 共享 agere「做」：agent 去做，agenda 列出要做的事。

normal.en: A hidden agenda is a list that the speaker keeps in a drawer.
normal.cn: hidden agenda 是说话人锁在抽屉里、不拿出来给人看的那张清单。

normal.en: The word ends in -a and is already plural; English simply adds s for several such lists.
normal.cn: 这个词以 -a 结尾且已是复数；要指多份清单时，英语才再加 s。

abstract.en: A list is a promise about the future: it fixes what will be talked about before anything is said.
abstract.cn: 清单是对未来的承诺：在开口之前，它先规定了要谈什么。

abstract.en: Whoever writes the list controls the room, which makes agenda-setting a quiet form of power.
abstract.cn: 写清单的人控制着这间屋子，这让议程设定成了一种安静的权利。

abstract.en: An unstated list still steers behaviour, so a hidden agenda can explain more than a spoken one.
abstract.cn: 没说出口的清单照样左右行为，所以隐藏的议程往往比公开的更能说明问题。

examples.en: The agenda for the annual meeting was sent out on Monday.
examples.cn: 年会的议程已在周一发出。

examples.en: Privacy is high on the agenda for this year's conference.
examples.cn: 隐私问题在今年的会议议程上排在很前面。

examples.en: She suspected that his sudden interest had a hidden agenda behind it.
examples.cn: 她怀疑他突然产生的兴趣背后另有目的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿珍的」——阿珍的记事本上，一行行全是今天要做的事。

root: 源自拉丁语 agere「做、驱动」，其动形词中性复数 agenda 意为「必须做的事」，因此英语 agenda 天生是复数名词。

sensesIntro.en: One list of things to be done runs through all four senses: a meeting's list, a person's tasks, a party's programme, and the list kept out of sight.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项贯穿着同一张「待办清单」：会议的清单、个人的任务、政党的纲领，以及藏在暗处的那张。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sheet of paper on a meeting table, items numbered and waiting to be ticked off.
core.cn: 核心意象：会议桌上一页纸，事项编号排好，等着被逐条划掉。

branches.en: a sheet read out at the start of a meeting
branches.cn: 会议开始时被念出来的那张纸

branches.en: a personal list of tasks for the day
branches.cn: 个人当天的事务清单

branches.en: a party's list of issues to push
branches.cn: 政党要推动的议题清单

branches.en: a list the speaker never shows
branches.cn: 说话人始终不拿出来给人看的清单

branches.en: one list image, stretched from meetings to politics
branches.cn: 同一个清单意象，从会议一路延伸到政治

intro.en: A Latin verb of doing, its gerundive ending, and ordinary English noun endings.
intro.cn: 一个表示「做」的拉丁动词、它的动形词词尾，以及普通的英语名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: agere and agenda are recorded Latin; only the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: agere 与 agenda 都是有文献记录的拉丁词，只有更早的印欧词根属重构。

items.meaning: the office or power of acting
plural of a Latin neuter noun
items.meaningCN: 拉丁中性名词复数词尾
英语复数词尾，加在 agenda 之后

definition_zh: 代理人；经纪人；特工；作用剂；施事者
definition_en: a person who acts on another's behalf, a person who secretly gathers information, or a substance that produces an effect
core_image: 站在两个人中间、替其中一人签字办事的那位中间人
scene: 机场柜台前，一位穿套装的职员一边翻手册一边打电话。The travel agent found her a seat on the last flight of the day.
sceneCN: 这里 agent 是「代理、经纪人」（第 1 个义项：受委托替他人办理事务的人）；句意为旅行社职员帮她订到了当天最后一班航班的座位。图中可辨识物件：柜台、手册、行李箱。

pos.zh: 名词：代理人；经纪人；特工；作用剂；施事者

collocations.zh: 自由身；可自主行动的人

derivatives.zh: 由本词同源拉丁词构成，义为「代理机构；能动性」
由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「代理人的；施事的」
由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「施事性的；表示施事的」
由 sub- 加本词构成，义为「副代理人；分代理商」

senses.title: One who acts for another
senses.definition: a person who is authorised to act on behalf of someone else, especially in business
senses.definitionCN: 获授权代表他人行事的人，尤指商业上的代理
senses.example: You can sign the lease through your agent instead of going in person.
senses.exampleCN: 你可以通过代理人签租约，不必亲自到场。
senses.why: Latin agens is the present participle of agere, 'to do', so an agent is simply the one doing the deal on another's account.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 agens 是 agere「做」的现在分词，所以 agent 就是替别人把这件事做成的那一方。

senses.title: A secret operative
senses.definition: a person employed to obtain secret information, especially for a government
senses.definitionCN: 受雇获取秘密情报的人，尤指为政府工作的特工
senses.example: The novel's hero is a British agent working under cover in Berlin.
senses.exampleCN: 小说的主人公是一名在柏林潜伏的英国特工。
senses.why: The spy is still 'one who acts', but acts for a state and in secret, so the neutral word for a doer took on this specialised sense.
senses.whyCN: 间谍仍然是「做事的人」，只是替国家做事、并且秘密地做，于是这个中性的「行动者」词获得了这一专门义。

senses.title: A substance that acts
senses.definition: a chemical or physical substance that produces a particular effect
senses.definitionCN: 能产生特定效果的化学或物理物质
senses.example: Soap is a cleaning agent that lifts grease from the skin.
senses.exampleCN: 肥皂是一种能带走皮肤油脂的清洁剂。
senses.why: Chemistry extended 'the one who acts' from people to substances: the agent is whatever brings the change about.
senses.whyCN: 化学把「行动者」从人扩展到物质：谁带来变化，谁就是 agent。

senses.title: The doer in a sentence
senses.definition: in grammar, the person or thing that performs the action of a verb, often omitted in the passive
senses.definitionCN: 语法上执行动词动作的人或物，在被动句中常被省略
senses.example: In the passive sentence, the agent may be left out entirely.
senses.exampleCN: 在被动句中，施事者可以完全省略。
senses.why: Grammarians needed a name for whichever phrase does the action, and the general word for a doer fitted exactly.
senses.whyCN: 语法学家需要一个名称来指执行动作的那个成分，而这个泛指「行动者」的词正好合适。

intro.en: Agent comes straight from the Latin present participle of agere, 'to do', so it names the one who is doing.
intro.cn: agent 直接来自拉丁语 agere「做」的现在分词，因此它指的就是「正在做的那一方」。

items.en: Agere meant 'to do, drive, lead', and it is one of the busiest verbs in Latin.
items.cn: agere 意为「做、驱动、带领」，是拉丁语中使用最频繁的动词之一。

items.en: The present participle agens, stem agent-, meant 'doing, the one who does'; the -t- belongs to the stem, not to a suffix.
items.cn: 现在分词 agens（词干 agent-）意为「正在做的、做事的人」；其中的 -t- 属于词干，不是后缀。

items.en: The abstract noun agentia named the office or activity of an agent, and it later gave English agency.
items.cn: 抽象名词 agentia 指代理人的职务或活动，后来给了英语 agency。

items.en: Old French passed the word on with the commercial and diplomatic senses already in place.
items.cn: 古法语把这个词传下来时，商业与外交上的用法已经具备。

items.en: English records agent first as 'one who acts or produces an effect', with the business sense following.
items.cn: 英语最早记录 agent 为「行动者、产生效果者」，商业义随后出现。

items.en: The spy sense grew in the nineteenth century, and the grammatical sense came from Latin grammar in the same period.
items.cn: 特工义在十九世纪发展起来，语法义也在同一时期随拉丁语法学进入英语。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the Latin family of agere; the near-meaning group gathers people who act for others or act in secret.
note.cn: 形近组收 agere 这一拉丁词族；近义组收替他人行事或在暗中行事的人。

entries.definition: A list of things that must be done or discussed.
entries.definitionCN: 必须去做或讨论的事项清单。

entries.definition: An organisation that acts for others, or the power to act.
entries.definitionCN: 代他人行事的机构，或行动的能力。

entries.definition: Relating to an agent or to the doer of an action.
entries.definitionCN: 与代理人或动作执行者有关的。

entries.definition: A person chosen to speak or act for a group.
entries.definitionCN: 被选出代表团体发言或行事的人。

entries.definition: A person who arranges deals between buyers and sellers for a fee.
entries.definitionCN: 收取费用、为买卖双方撮合交易的人。

entries.definition: A messenger or diplomat sent to represent a government.
entries.definitionCN: 被派去代表政府的信使或外交使节。

normalIntro.en: Three real parts carry the word: the verb agere, its participle stem agent-, and the ending -ent.
normalIntro.cn: 三个真实部件承载这个词：动词 agere、它的分词词干 agent-，以及词尾 -ent。

normal.en: Agent and agenda share agere, 'to do': the agent does, the agenda lists what is to be done.
normal.cn: agent 与 agenda 共享 agere「做」：agent 去做，agenda 列出要做的事。

normal.en: An agent is the -ent person on the end of the verb: the one doing it.
normal.cn: agent 就是动词后面那个 -ent 的人：正在做这件事的那位。

normal.en: Travel agent, secret agent, cleaning agent: each is a helper that acts for someone or something.
normal.cn: 旅行代理、特工、清洁剂：每一个都是替别人或别物出力的角色。

normal.en: Remember agency as the place where many agents work.
normal.cn: 把 agency 记成许多 agent 一起办公的那个地方。

normal.en: Agent keeps the t of the Latin stem agent-, so the spelling is agent, not agen.
normal.cn: agent 保留了拉丁词干 agent- 里的 t，所以拼作 agent 而不是 agen。

abstract.en: An agent is proof that action can be delegated: one will can be carried out by another hand.
abstract.cn: 代理人证明了行动可以委托：一个人的意志可以由另一双手去完成。

abstract.en: The same word covers a clerk, a spy and a chemical, because all three change a situation without being the situation.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指职员、又指特工与化学剂，因为这三者都在改变局面，而它们本身并不是局面。

abstract.en: Naming the doer is a way of asking who is responsible, which is why the grammar term matters beyond grammar.
abstract.cn: 点明施事者，等于在问谁该负责，所以这个语法术语的意义不止于语法。

examples.en: Our agent in Shanghai handles all the shipping paperwork.
examples.cn: 我们在上海的代理处理所有货运单据。

examples.en: The intelligence agent had been living under a false name for years.
examples.cn: 那名情报特工多年来一直用假名生活。

examples.en: Adding a thickening agent makes the sauce cling to the pasta.
examples.cn: 加入增稠剂能让酱汁挂在面条上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「诶真特」——诶，真特工，名片背面只印着一个代号。

root: 源自拉丁语 agere「做、驱动」的现在分词 agens（词干 agent-），本义「正在做事的人」，由此引申出代理人、施事者与作用剂。

sensesIntro.en: One image of someone or something that acts runs through the senses: a proxy, a spy, a chemical that acts on dirt, and the doer in a sentence.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项共用同一个「行动者」意象：代理人、间谍、对污垢起作用的有效成分，以及句子里的施事者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person standing between two parties, pen in hand, signing on someone else's behalf.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在两方之间，手里握着笔，替另一方签字。

branches.en: a clerk signing a lease for a client
branches.cn: 替客户签租约的职员

branches.en: a courier passing envelopes in a station
branches.cn: 在车站交接信封的联络人

branches.en: soap lifting grease from a plate
branches.cn: 把盘子上的油带走的那点皂液

branches.en: the doer left out of a passive clause
branches.cn: 被动句里被省去的那个施事

branches.en: one acting root, four kinds of actor
branches.cn: 同一个「行动」词根，四种行动者

intro.en: A Latin verb of doing, its present participle, and English endings that build nouns and adjectives.
intro.cn: 一个表示「做」的拉丁动词、它的现在分词，以及构成名词和形容词的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: agere, agens and agentia are recorded Latin; only the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: agere、agens 与 agentia 都是有文献记录的拉丁词，只有更早的印欧词根属重构。
