senses.title: A company that flies passengers
senses.definition: a company that operates regular flights carrying passengers or cargo
senses.definitionCN: 经营定期航班、运送旅客或货物的公司
senses.example: The airline offered vouchers to passengers whose flight was cancelled.
senses.exampleCN: 这家航空公司给航班取消的乘客发了代金券。
senses.why: The word began as a line on a map, and the company that ran flights along those lines took the name of the line itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原本指地图上的一条线，而沿着这些线经营航班的公司，最终用了「线」这个名字。

senses.title: A route, in older use
senses.definition: in older use, a route followed by aircraft between two places, now usually called a route
senses.definitionCN: 早期用法中指飞机往返两地所走的路线，如今多称 route
senses.example: The old airline across the mountains was flown only in summer.
senses.exampleCN: 那条穿越山区的旧航线只在夏季运营。
senses.why: Before companies took the name, an airline was literally the line drawn on a chart, and that older sense survives in historical writing.
senses.whyCN: 在公司采用这个名字之前，airline 字面上就是海图上画出的一条线，这个旧义仍留在历史叙述里。

intro.en: Airline is a map word that became a business word: first the line between two places, then the company that flies it.
intro.cn: airline 是一个从地图词变成商业词的例子：先指两地之间的线，后指飞这条线的公司。

items.en: Airline first meant a straight line between two points, especially the shortest distance across land.
items.cn: airline 最初指两点之间的直线，尤指陆地上最短的距离。

items.en: With aviation the word shifted to a route flown by aircraft between cities.
items.cn: 随着航空发展，这个词转指飞机在城市之间飞行的路线。

items.en: Companies operating those routes took the name, so airline came to mean the operator as well as the route.
items.cn: 经营这些航线的公司采用了这个名字，于是 airline 既指航线，也指经营者。

items.en: The company sense became dominant, while airliner was coined for the aircraft itself.
items.cn: 公司义成为主要义项，同时另造 airliner 指飞机本身。

items.en: The route sense now sounds dated and is usually replaced by route or service.
items.cn: 航线义如今听来陈旧，通常用 route 或 service 代替。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the airline family and its near neighbours; the near-meaning group gathers travel businesses and routes.
note.cn: 形近组收 airline 词族及其邻近词；近义组收旅行企业与航线类说法。

entries.definition: The course travelled from one place to another.

entries.definition: One journey made by an aircraft.

normalIntro.en: Two real parts carry the word: air and line, the line drawn between two cities on a map.
normalIntro.cn: 两个真实部件承载这个词：air 与 line，也就是地图上两座城市之间画的那条线。

normal.en: An airline was first a line in the air between two cities, then the company that flew it.
normal.cn: airline 先是两座城市之间空中的一条线，后来才是飞这条线的公司。

normal.en: Add -r and the company becomes a machine: airliner is the plane.
normal.cn: 加一个 r，公司就变成机器：airliner 指飞机。

normal.en: A budget airline sells cheap seats; the word budget tells you the business model.
normal.cn: budget airline 卖便宜座位，budget 这个词就说明了商业模式。

normal.en: Keep the two parts: air-line, one word, no hyphen in modern use.
normal.cn: 两个部件是 air 与 line，现代拼写连写成一个词，不加连字符。

normal.en: The stress is on air: AIR-line.
normal.cn: 重音在 air 上：AIR-line。

abstract.en: A line on a map became a company, which shows how much of business naming is borrowed geography.
abstract.cn: 地图上的一条线变成了一家公司，说明商业命名借用了多少地理词汇。

abstract.en: The airline sells not the plane but the connection between two places.
abstract.cn: 航空公司卖的其实不是飞机，而是两地之间的连接。

abstract.en: That the route sense faded shows how quickly a new industry can take over an old word.
abstract.cn: 航线义逐渐消失，说明一个新行业能多快地把一个旧词据为己有。

definition_en: a powered flying vehicle with fixed wings, or travel by such a vehicle
core_image: 一架银色的固定翼飞机掠过云层，机翼在光里微微发亮
scene: 机场外的草地上，一个孩子仰头看天，手指跟着那道白线移动。A small airplane climbed slowly above the trees.
sceneCN: 这里 airplane 是「飞机」（第 1 个义项：有固定机翼的动力飞行器）；句意为一架小飞机缓缓爬升到树梢之上。图中可辨识物件：草地、白线、机翼。

pos.zh: 名词：飞机；（乘）飞机

senses.title: A fixed-wing flying machine
senses.definition: a powered flying vehicle with fixed wings and an engine, the usual American term
senses.definitionCN: 有固定机翼与发动机的动力飞行器，美式英语的常用说法
senses.example: A small airplane climbed slowly above the trees.
senses.exampleCN: 一架小飞机缓缓爬升到树梢之上。
senses.why: Airplane is a transparent compound of air and plane, where plane is the old word for a flat surface, because the wings are flat.
senses.whyCN: airplane 是 air 与 plane 的透明复合词，而 plane 本指平面，因为机翼是平的。

senses.title: Air travel as a means
senses.definition: in phrases such as by airplane, the means of travelling by air rather than a particular machine
senses.definitionCN: 在 by airplane 这类说法中，指乘飞机这一交通方式，而不是某一架具体的飞机
senses.example: The team travels by airplane when the distance is too long for a bus.
senses.exampleCN: 距离太远、坐大巴不合适时，这支队伍就乘飞机。
senses.why: When the word follows by, it names a mode rather than an object, the same shift that turns bicycle into a way of travelling.
senses.whyCN: 跟在 by 后面时，它命名的是一种方式而非一件物体，这与 bicycle 变成一种出行方式的变化相同。

intro.en: Airplane is an American compound: air plus plane, the old word for a flat surface, named for the flat wings.
intro.cn: airplane 是美式复合词：air 加上 plane，而 plane 本指平面，得名于平坦的机翼。

items.en: Planum meant 'a flat surface', from planus 'flat', the source of plain and plane.
items.cn: planum 意为「平面」，出自 planus「平的」，plain 与 plane 都源于此。

items.en: English plane named a flat surface and a woodworking tool, and later one surface of a wing.
items.cn: 英语 plane 指平面与木工刨，后来也指机翼的一面。

items.en: Early aviation writing used aeroplane in Britain and airplane in America, both built on the flat-wing idea.
items.cn: 早期航空文献在英国用 aeroplane、在美国用 airplane，两者都建立在「平翼」这个想法上。

items.en: Airplane became standard American usage, while aeroplane remained British.
items.cn: airplane 成为美式标准，aeroplane 则留在英式英语中。

items.en: The clipped form plane is now common everywhere, and airplane mode keeps the full word in daily use.
items.cn: 缩略形式 plane 如今各地通用，而 airplane mode 让完整形式仍活跃在日常里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the plane family and its spelling rivals; the near-meaning group gathers flying machines by type.
note.cn: 形近组收 plane 词族与拼写上的对手；近义组收按类型区分的飞行器。

entries.definition: The short everyday word for an airplane, or a flat surface.
entries.definitionCN: 飞机的日常简称，或指平面。

entries.definition: Simple, ordinary, or a flat stretch of land.
entries.definitionCN: 朴素的、普通的，或指平原。

entries.definition: Any flying machine, including helicopters and balloons.
entries.definitionCN: 任何飞行器，包括直升机与气球。

entries.definition: An aircraft driven by jet engines, usually fast and large.
entries.definitionCN: 由喷气发动机驱动的飞机，通常又快又大。

entries.definition: A plane with no engine that rides rising air.
entries.definitionCN: 没有发动机、借上升气流飞行的飞机。

normalIntro.en: Two real parts carry the word: air and plane, the flat surface of a wing.
normalIntro.cn: 两个真实部件承载这个词：air 与 plane，也就是机翼的平面。

normal.en: Plane is a flat surface, and a wing is flat: airplane is literally a flat thing in the air.
normal.cn: plane 是平面，而机翼是平的：airplane 字面上就是「空中的平面」。

normal.en: Britain keeps aeroplane, America uses airplane; the aero- part points to air as well.
normal.cn: 英国保留 aeroplane，美国用 airplane；aero- 这个成分同样指向空气。

normal.en: Airplane mode switches the radio off, not the plane.
normal.cn: airplane mode 关掉的是无线电，不是飞机。

normal.en: The verb is not used: you do not airplane somewhere, you fly there.
normal.cn: 这个词不作动词：不能说 airplane 到某地，要说 fly。

normal.en: Plane, plain and plane again: only airplane always means the machine.
normal.cn: plane、plain、plane 容易混：只有 airplane 始终指机器。

abstract.en: Naming a machine after a flat surface shows how concrete the roots of technology words usually are.
abstract.cn: 用平面来命名机器，说明技术词根通常多么具体。

abstract.en: Two spellings for one object record two histories of the same invention.
abstract.cn: 同一个物体有两种拼写，记录了同一项发明的两段历史。

abstract.en: By airplane names a way of travelling, which is why it needs no article.
abstract.cn: by airplane 命名的是一种出行方式，所以不需要冠词。

examples.cn: 他把信折成一架飞机，扔过整个房间。

sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都出自同一台机器：机器本身，以及这台机器所实现的出行方式。
